focused.claim: unexecuted refusal on Linux; not macOS proof

findings.failure: No test loads a real launchd job. Lifecycle tests use kind systemd and a fake systemctl. macos-native.yml and native-platform.test.ts:19-27 lint a plist without bootstrap.
findings.affected_invariant: RFC 0002 §11 / docs/service-lifecycle.md: liveness and install/uninstall must be confirmed against the supervisor; synthetic adapters are not installed-service proof
findings.required_fix: P092 run /work/out/macos-launchd-lifecycle.sh on Darwin arm64 with KIZUKI_BIN. Do not duplicate systemd fakes.

findings.failure: Query classifies state=disabled if stdout+stderr lowercased includes substring 'disabled' before checking state = running and pid.
findings.affected_invariant: confirmedActive requires state=active; a false disabled classification would fail install confirmation
findings.required_fix: On Darwin, record whether launchctl print of a running job contains 'disabled'. If yes, parser must be tightened. Do not change source in this packet.

findings.failure: Product treats launchctl print as the production source of truth. Public man-page text says print is for debugging and should not be relied upon in production.
findings.required_fix: Retain as residual risk; native observation should copy raw print text. Citation: https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/launchctl.1.html fetched 2026-09-06 (mirror, not Apple-hosted).

findings.failure: KeepAlive is true; serve stop only SIGTERMs the pid file. Supervisor may restart. Uninstall is bootout plus plist delete.
findings.required_fix: Observation script already separates stop from uninstall. Do not treat stop as removal.

blockers: Darwin arm64 host with launchctl, plutil, non-root gui/<uid> domain, and bun-darwin-arm64 kizuki binary
macos-native.yml remains cost-gated; this packet did not start a runner
next_step: P092: on authorized macos-15 arm64, set KIZUKI_BIN to the native kizuki, OUT to an evidence directory, run macos-launchd-lifecycle.sh, retain independent launchctl print fields and vault snapshots. Rebase before production use.
